reason: The candidate action uses modify_pending_order_items with an empty new_item_ids array, which does not match any policy-authorized action. The policy explicitly states that for a pending order, 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' This requires providing replacement items, not removing items. Modifying items to different variants requires both item_ids and new_item_ids to be populated. An empty new_item_ids array represents item removal, not modification, and item removal is not authorized under the policy's Modify Items section. The user's request—to cancel specific items while keeping others—cannot be fulfilled using the authorized modify or cancel tools (canceling the whole order would refund all items). This scenario exceeds the scope of available actions and should have triggered a transfer to human agent.
policy_references: Modify pending order: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Generic action rules: Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.
Cancel pending order: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending'... the total will be refunded
